purpose: Require preregistered locked-forward positive cost-after return, capital-preservation risk, bias, and exact execution-path evidence before a future portfolio can be considered for promotion. Ten percent net monthly return remains aspirational rather than a pass/fail gate.

selection_bias_audit.single_trial_exemption: PBO only; permitted solely for one preregistered trial. DSR remains mandatory.

portfolio_risk_audit.source: consecutive 00:00 UTC portfolio mark-to-market equity after fees and funding
portfolio_risk_audit.probability_gate_statistic: one-sided Wilson upper bounds for ruin and terminal loss; one-sided Wilson lower bound for annual-target attainment

deterministic_tail_recurrence.worst_block_selection: maximize repeated-path drawdown; break ties by lower terminal return, then earlier source index

portfolio_composition_audit.source: one UTC-midnight row per portfolio MTM return with exact manifest-ordered allocation-weighted net PnL contribution columns

portfolio_performance_audit.daily_exposure_must_cover_trade_overlap_: for each UTC day, sweep all overlapping closed-trade intervals using max(entry_notional, exit_notional) and divide gross and absolute-net maxima by min(start-MTM, end-MTM) equity; reported daily maxima may not be lower
portfolio_performance_audit.daily_mtm_accounting_identity: gross_price_pnl - trading_fees + funding_pnl - modeled_slippage = change in mark-to-market equity
portfolio_performance_audit.trade_to_daily_component_reconciliation: gross_price_pnl, trading_fees, funding_pnl, and modeled_slippage must each reconcile independently; matching net PnL alone is insufficient
portfolio_performance_audit.natural_trade_definition: all closed trades except force_exit and liquidation
portfolio_performance_audit.cost_stress_source: daily MTM accounting ledger, including realized and unrealized price PnL and all open/closed-position costs
portfolio_performance_audit.simultaneous_stress_path: replay the daily accounting ledger in chronological order; terminal return must stay positive, equity must never become non-positive, and maximum drawdown must be <= 0.10
portfolio_performance_audit.preregistered_execution_cost_floor: for every closed trade, recorded trading fees must cover the manifest fee_bps for entry and exit notionals, and recorded fees plus modeled slippage must cover the manifest maximum_all_in_drag_bps for both order roles

selection_bias_methodology.deflated_sharpe_ratio: Correct the selected Sharpe for non-normal returns and the expected maximum produced by all disclosed trials.
selection_bias_methodology.cscv_probability_of_backtest_overfitting: Select the in-sample winner over symmetric contiguous partitions and count below-median out-of-sample ranks.

portfolio_risk_methodology.purpose: Prevent a one-week bootstrap from understating multi-week loss clustering in swing portfolios.
portfolio_risk_methodology.aggregation: Use the worse probability/drawdown and lower target probability across 7-day and 28-day contiguous-block scenarios.
portfolio_risk_methodology.deterministic_tail_stress: For each 1-day, 7-day, and 28-day window, select the block maximizing repeated-path drawdown (ties: lower terminal return, then earlier index), repeat it three, four, and two times respectively, and reject if any path exceeds 10% drawdown.

v17_amendment: The 10% monthly objective is aspirational only. Promotion requires positive cost-after return, 1x or lower leverage, 10% or lower historical/bootstrap/deterministic/cost-stress drawdown, 0.5% or lower upper-bound ruin probability, and 5% or lower upper-bound terminal-loss probability. The machine_policy and portfolio_requirements are canonical where older narrative text differs.
interpretation: This policy does not alter active alpha protocols and cannot authorize orders. It becomes applicable only after at least two sleeves independently pass locked-forward gates. V16 requires the portfolio manifest to preregister the exact selection-bias family and inventory IDs for the portfolio and every sleeve, preventing post-sample substitution among multiple sealed inventories. It reconstructs each sleeve's self-financing equity and daily return path from its preregistered initial weight plus source-replayed net PnL, rejects non-positive sleeve equity, measures pairwise diversification on those self-financing sleeve returns, measures positive-PnL concentration on source sleeve net PnL rather than portfolio-equity-scaled contributions, and requires the selected DSR/PBO trial-return SHA-256 to equal that promoted sleeve return series; the portfolio selected trial must likewise equal the MTM daily-return series. It also binds every claimed sleeve contribution to the source-replayed daily sleeve net-PnL series, the claimed locked start/end to the source-replayed MTM boundaries and the identical window for every sleeve; requires sealed trial inventories, source-replayed 7/28-day portfolio MTM risk audits, >=1.20 daily MTM profit factor independently of trade grouping, <=20% maximum intratrade leverage-adjusted MAE, overlap-derived daily gross/net exposure lower-bound reconciliation, trade-to-daily reconciliation for every PnL component, per-trade fee and all-in cost floors, chronological simultaneous fee/slippage/funding stress with no interim insolvency and <=20% drawdown, and source-replayed execution observations for every order path, rejecting unrelated or substituted selection-bias evidence, fabricated diversification, post-observation registration, incomplete, changed, statistically overfit, downside-fragile, loss-reclassified, leverage-understated, under-costed, accounting-inconsistent, grouping-sensitive, or unsupported execution evidence.
